subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a correct pair of a UN organ and its headquarters?

options.text: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) - Paris
The International Court of Justice (ICJ) - The Hague

solution:
The correct answer is __**World Health Organization (WHO) - New York**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **World Health Organization (WHO)** is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health.
 
• WHO was established on 7 April 1948 and is headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**.
 
• The main goal of WHO is to build a better, healthier future for people all over the world.
 
• WHO works in more than 150 countries, collaborating with governments and other partners to ensure the highest attainable level of health for all people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)**

 
 
• UNESCO was founded on 16 November 1945.
 
• It is headquartered in **Paris, France**.
 
• The organization aims to build peace through international cooperation in education, the sciences, and culture.
 
 
 
• **The International Court of Justice (ICJ)**
 
 
• ICJ, also known as the World Court, is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations.
 
• It is headquartered in **The Hague, Netherlands**.
 
• It was established in June 1945 by the Charter of the United Nations and began work in April 1946.
 
 
 
• **International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)**
 
 
• The IAEA was established as an autonomous organization on 29 July 1957.
 
• It is headquartered in **Vienna, Austria**.
 
• The IAEA works with its Member States and multiple partners worldwide to promote the safe, secure and peaceful use of nuclear technologies.
